description: Hash-anchored source extracts for class-based NPC creation (NPC_MODE_PLAN.md Phase 0). Anchors the local Core Rulebook excerpt and official Archives of Nethys snapshots, curates fragments consumed by the NPC catalog builders, and records the remaining source gaps.

extraction.note: Extract line ranges are stable because every parent file and derived text file is immutable and hash-anchored. Downstream code does not fetch live web pages or re-run PDF extraction.

core-rulebook-pdf.description: 16-page Core Rulebook PDF excerpt: complete class spell lists (Bard 0-6, Cleric 0-9, Druid 0-9, Paladin 1-4, Ranger 1-4, Sorcerer/Wizard 0-9) plus the first alphabetical spell descriptions. This is the ONLY local Core Rulebook content; NPC creation pages 448-454, races, class tables, skills, feats, equipment, and Appendix gear tables are not present.

core-rulebook-txt-legacy.description: Existing 1749-line extraction of the 16-page spell excerpt; anchored by catalog/catalog.json as pathfinder-core-txt. Must not be modified.

pathfinder-unchained-txt.description: Existing full Simple Monster Creation chapter (5566 lines); anchored by catalog/catalog.json as pathfinder-unchained-txt. Must not be modified.

bestiary-txt.description: Existing 2-page Bestiary appendix: Table 1-1 (Monster Statistics by CR) and Table 1-2 (Creature Hit Dice by CR); anchored by catalog/catalog.json as bestiary-txt.

aon-creating-npcs-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys Creating NPCs page: Core Rulebook pages 448-454, including Steps 1-7, Tables 14-6 through 14-9, and Kiramor.

aon-core-races-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys legacy Core Rulebook race chapter.

aon-character-classes-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys legacy Core Rulebook class and advancement rules.

aon-npc-classes-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys legacy Core Rulebook tables and rules for the five NPC classes.

aon-skills-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys legacy Core Rulebook rules for acquiring and using skills.

aon-skill-descriptions-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys legacy Core Rulebook skill summary table and skill-description conventions.

aon-feats-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys legacy Core Rulebook feat rules, table, and descriptions.

aon-equipment-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys legacy Core Rulebook mundane equipment rules and tables.

aon-combat-html.description: Official Archives of Nethys legacy Core Rulebook combat rules.

core-rulebook-extract.contents: Complete spell-list chapter for Bard (0-6), Cleric (0-9), Druid (0-9), Paladin (1-4), Ranger (1-4), Sorcerer/Wizard (0-9), followed by the opening of the alphabetical spell descriptions (roughly the letter A: Acid Fog, Acid Splash, Air Walker, Astral Projection, Energy Drain, Etherealness, Shapechange, Soul Bind, Time Stop, Wail of the Banshee, Wish). Two-column PDF; reading order is reliable in the list section, partially scrambled in the description section.
core-rulebook-extract.catalogUse: NPC spell lists (adept = cleric/druid lists; PC casters) for tasks 3.b and 5.a.

core-rulebook-extract-spell-lists.contents: Spell-list portion only: complete class lists for Bard (0-6), Cleric (0-9), Druid (0-9), Paladin (1-4), Ranger (1-4), and Sorcerer/Wizard (0-9), ending immediately before the alphabetical spell-description section. Two-column extraction losses: the cleric 7th-level and druid 3rd-level lists are empty in the excerpt at page boundaries; the parser records these as emptySections.
core-rulebook-extract-spell-lists.catalogUse: Stable parse target for spell list membership in the NPC catalog (tools/parse_npc_sources.py).

aon-creating-npcs.contents: Creating NPCs Steps 1-7, ability arrays and presets, racial adjustments, simplified skill ranks, feat recommendations, NPC gear budgets and allocations, and the Kiramor worked example.
aon-creating-npcs.catalogUse: Authoritative workflow and numeric tables for class-based NPC creation.

aon-core-races.contents: Core racial traits for dwarf, elf, gnome, half-elf, half-orc, halfling, and human.

aon-character-classes.contents: Class selection, level advancement, favored-class, multiclassing, and general feat and ability-score advancement rules.

aon-npc-classes.contents: Adept, aristocrat, commoner, expert, and warrior class rules and level tables.
aon-npc-classes.catalogUse: Basic NPC class tables and features.

aon-skills.contents: Skill ranks, class-skill bonus, rank cap, checks, and armor check penalty rule.

aon-skill-descriptions.contents: Core skill names, PC class-skill assignments, key abilities, trained-only flags, and armor check penalty applicability.
aon-skill-descriptions.catalogUse: Core skill records and PC class-skill mappings.

aon-feats.contents: Core feat progression, feat table, prerequisites, benefits, and descriptions.
aon-feats.catalogUse: Core feat records and typed prerequisites.

aon-equipment.contents: Core mundane weapons, armor, goods, services, prices, damage, maximum Dexterity bonuses, and armor check penalties.
aon-equipment.catalogUse: Mundane item records and equipment-derived statistics.

aon-combat.contents: Core combat calculations and rules for attacks, AC, saves, initiative, CMB, CMD, and iterative attacks.

pathfinder-unchained-npc-likeness.contents: Simple Monster Creation guidance that a monster meant to be more like an NPC, especially one using a PC race, should avoid monstrous combat options.
pathfinder-unchained-npc-likeness.catalogUse: Policy grounding: NPC-likeness expectations and the future Simple Monster comparison benchmark (plan section 13).

bestiary-table-1-1.contents: Bestiary Table 1-1: Monster Statistics by CR (CR 1/2 through 20 rows).
bestiary-table-1-1.catalogUse: Future draft.compareBenchmarks comparisons (plan section 13); never used to compute NPC statistics.

core-rulebook-pc-class-pages.consequence: Heroic PC-class catalog rows remain source gaps.

core-rulebook-magic-items.consequence: Mundane item prices and NPC gear budgets are anchored; heroic magic-item records remain source gaps.

core-rulebook-spell-descriptions.consequence: Spell-list membership is locally anchored; per-spell rules beyond the fragment remain gaps.

core-rulebook-conditions.availability: Available in the official Archives of Nethys Core rules but not yet archived locally.
core-rulebook-conditions.consequence: Rules text that depends on unsnapshotted condition definitions remains a source gap.
